newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0810 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to up 0.100 cent. Carryover seen after packer held $63 level but falling beef bearish.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady. Index down as nearterm trend in cash markets easier but corn futures called lower.
LEAN HOGS - Up 0.200 to off 0.100 cent. Carryover likely on steady to firm live calls but lower pork may spark selling.
PORK BELLIES - Steady to off 0.200 cent. Further pressure seen from delining cash belly market.
